description: Defines the DistributionCaller template struct for intercepting distribution calls in the absl::random_internal namespace, including mock support and detection mechanisms.

classes.name: DistributionCaller
classes.description: Template struct providing mechanisms to call and mock distribution objects within the absl::random_internal namespace.

methods.name: Impl
methods.description: Default implementation of distribution call, invokes distribution with provided arguments.

methods.name: Impl (mock version)
methods.description: Mock implementation that attempts to invoke a mock method; falls back to default if mock is not invoked.

methods.name: Call
methods.description: Public interface to invoke distribution call, selecting between mock and default implementations.
